## Problem and result

Describe the problem and what someone will experience after this change. Link an issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For a behavior fix, describe the regression test. For a performance change, include the baseline and evidence that required context and checks are preserved.

## Remaining limits

Mention known gaps, compatibility changes, or checks you could not run. Write "None" if there are no known limits specific to this change.

- [ ] The diff is focused and contains no private source, journals, credentials, or personal instructions.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed command or contract.
- [ ] Upstream work and new dependencies have compatible licenses and appropriate credit.
